description: This file defines the NetNode class, which extends PcbNode, representing a network node with an identifier and an optional name, specifically used in PCB design context. It includes logic to identify ground nodes and prints information during instantiation.

classes.name: NetNode
classes.description: A subclass of PcbNode representing a network node with attributes such as id and name, and special handling for ground nodes.

methods.name: NetNode
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the NetNode with a name, an ID, and a list of children, setting static GND_NET_ID if the node is a ground node.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the NetNode, showing its id.
